title: Just meh
text:
I get my 2 dogs the barkbox, so I thought it would be fair to get my 2 cats the same equivilent. But this is nowhere near the same quality.

When I get a box, I expect to get a deal. They buy things in bulk at a great price, pack things into boxes for us, and it should cost less than getting the items individually. I honestly feel like I could have done better with $10 dollars at Walmart than this box did for $20. The quality of the toys was sub-par, and the treats were nothing special. The items were than Dollar Tree items but not nearly as good as PetSmart.
label: negative
